R8 detached root reattach attended matrix

This offline fixture validates the R8-DETACHED-ROOT1 (inheriting R7-COVERAGE-RECOVERY1 and R6-SHADOW-SENTINEL1 v0.4.0) top-layer shadow sentinel, coverage recovery, and detached root reattachment. It tests early inline closed roots (first script), closed modal dialogs, closed popovers, late open/closed shadow attachment, nested shadow roots, declarative shadow DOM (DSD) fail-closed suspension, budget saturation (>256 roots), coverage throttling on 600-element batch mutations, structural >60000-node subtree backoff, captured closed popover inside retained closed root detachment, mutation and reattachment, record-only foreign-realm shadow root attempt, and visible root rails recovery after dismissal. Retained challenge scenes (root-after, root-mask, root-clip, multi scrollers) verify ongoing occlusion resistance.

For visible cases: drag thumb, click track, and wheel over the rail strip. When closed-shadow modal or popover UI is open, all Browser UX rails must suspend. Upon closing, visible root rails must recover cleanly. Permanent failure triggers (DSD APIs, >256 budget overflow) must latch fail-closed permanently.

s1 Early inline closed root first script

Created by the first inline script before subsequent document parse. In Chrome and Firefox, the isolated coverage walk discovers author roots. If captured, rails remain active; if uncaptured, the sentinel latches UNCAPTURED_ROOT and suspends fail-closed.

Normal root document scroller and control nested scroller. Verifies startup announcement {v:1,type:"ready"} and isolated request exchange.

s3 Closed-shadow modal dialog

Modal dialog inside a closed shadow root. Opening the modal must suspend all extension rails; closing it must recover visible root rails cleanly.

s4 Closed-shadow popover

Popover element inside a closed shadow root. Opening the popover must suspend all extension rails; closing it must recover visible root rails cleanly.

s5 Late open shadow root

Open shadow root attached after initial discovery walk. Opening a modal inside must be detected via root instrumentation and suspend rails.

s6 Late closed shadow root

Closed shadow root attached after initial discovery walk. Wrapped attachShadow registers the root. Opening a modal inside must suspend rails.

s7 Nested shadow roots

Closed shadow root nested inside an outer open or closed shadow root. Verifies multi-level traversal and root-local listeners.

s8 Declarative shadow DOM (DSD) fail-closed

In dsd-parser, a parser-created closed root must keep all custom rails absent. In dsd, invoking a DSD parsing API permanently suspends rails. Reload between these scenes; absence after the trigger is the required observation.

s9 Shadow root budget exceeded (>256 roots)

Attaching more than 256 author shadow roots exceeds the safety budget (ROOT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED). Document permanently latches fail-closed.

s17 Per-engine early closed root branch evaluation

Record whether the early inline closed root was captured (CAPTURED), suspended safely (NOT_CAPTURED_FAIL_CLOSED), or failed open (FAIL). Passes only on CAPTURED; NOT_CAPTURED_FAIL_CLOSED records a manager limit hold.

s18 Continuously changing content

The counter inserts and removes a small span every 100 ms. Drag the custom root rail continuously for at least five seconds; it must remain visible and keep scrolling. Then open and close the early closed-root modal and popover: rails must disappear while open and return after dismissal.

s19 Coverage throttle and structural recovery

Validates work budget suspension and structural backoff recovery for R7 coverage recovery:

  • 600-element batch insertion: A single-batch mutation of 600 elements exceeds the 512-record/node callback budget. Custom rails must suspend immediately, then return after cooldown without further mutation.
  • Structural >60000-node subtree: A subtree exceeding the 60,000-node safety walk limit suspends rails for at least 10s until shrunk. Structural backoff starts at 1s and doubles up to 30s (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 30s); there is no automatic retry while the document remains quiet.

s20 Detached closed root reattachment & foreign realm

Validates captured closed popover inside retained closed root detachment, mutation and reattachment, and foreign realm attempt for R8:

  • Captured closed popover inside retained closed root: An author closed shadow root contains a closed-root popover. Detaching the host from the document retains the root in JavaScript. Mutate the detached root and reattach it to the document. Opening the closed popover must suspend all extension rails; closing it must recover visible root rails cleanly.
  • Record-only foreign-realm attempt: Attaching or interacting with a shadow root across a foreign realm (e.g. from an iframe document) does not make a capture claim and fails closed safely.
